options.content:
SYSTEM_DESIGN budgets **p50 under 15ms and p99 under 60ms of overhead** — that is the request minus the downstream call, not the request total. The panels below decompose it so a regression can be attributed rather than merely noticed.

One honest gap: identity verification, canonicalization and the result store are not individually timed, so the *Unattributed* series below is everything the named panels do not account for. If a regression lands there, the next step is to time those steps rather than to guess.

panels.title: Overhead — request minus downstream (the budget)
panels.description: The quantity SYSTEM_DESIGN budgets. Thresholds mark 15ms and 60ms.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"POST /v1/writes"}[5m]))) - histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_downstream_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"POST /v1/writes"}[5m]))) - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_downstream_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Claim transaction — resource lock wait
panels.description: Budgeted at 6ms for the whole claim transaction; this is the share spent waiting for the per-resource advisory lock (ADR-0015). Also the ADR-0010 routing trigger at 50ms.

panels.title: Downstream call — excluded from the budget
panels.description: Split by disposition so timeouts do not flatter the success percentiles.

panels.title: Unattributed — overhead the panels above do not explain
panels.description: Overhead minus lock wait. Identity verification, canonicalization, the intent insert and the result store all land here because none of them is individually timed. A regression that shows up only here is the signal to add a timer, not to guess.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"POST /v1/writes"}[5m]))) - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_downstream_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(idemio_lock_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Correctness debt — the panel that should stay at zero
panels.description: Every indeterminate key is a possible unresolved side effect requiring a human.
